question_text: For each department that is degree granting (excluding Chemistry), what is the department name, the average of the total units, and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), and, for departments that match the Mathematics department (the department with the highest number of undergraduate degree-granting courses), also show the department name, school name, and the number of such courses? List the results in order by department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
